modules.name: Residuals and repeated native runs
modules.summary: Independent arithmetic and interpolation checks, strict coverage/version guards and actual repeat after reopening.

modules.name: Existing canvas and measurement controls
modules.summary: File chooser, explicit mappings, source notes, chart, history, repeat and reports stay in the present layout.

modules.name: Typed local-model comparison tools
modules.summary: gpt-oss:20b creates and runs the requested scene, compares a retained dataset and generates a real tested report.

modules.name: Application offline and model admission
modules.summary: Fresh digest/remote metadata checks and no redirects. External browser navigation and subresources are blocked in offline mode; not an OS-wide sandbox.

modules.name: Cached startup and source recovery
modules.summary: A validated cache is not replaced just for a missing stamp. Corrupted renderer sources stop startup; the committed theme is preserved.
